entities.summary: Urmila Balavant Apte is the Indian Founder of the Bhartiya Stree Shakti organisation in 1988 which is dedicated to the empowerment of women. She received the Nari Shakti Puraskar from President Ram Nath Kovind in 2018 for her work.
